unit.name: Royal Herald
unit.design: Lean youthful male royal herald, chestnut hair, open face, small blue feathered cap, gold-trim royal-blue fitted coat with ivory split skirt, light brass pauldrons, blue rear half-cape, fitted trousers and brown knee boots. Mobile court messenger silhouette, not full plate Knight. Equipment separate brass herald trumpet with small royal-blue pennant and short ceremonial sword.
unit.gear: brass herald trumpet with small royal-blue pennant and short ceremonial sword

body:
Create production modular 2D cutout sprite assets for Hollow Vale, Arcane Vanguard cel-shaded illustration: crisp black contours, flat shadow planes, clean high-contrast game art. TRUE TRANSPARENT background, no shadows, text, labels or grid lines. Large square image ideally3072x3072. Exactly SIX DIRECTION PANELS arranged three panels across by two panels down. Each panel contains TWELVE ISOLATED DISCONNECTED BODY PARTS in its own 3-column by4-row grid. Overall image therefore9columns by8rows of pieces,72 pieces total. Do NOT draw assembled characters. Every piece entirely in its own evenly spaced cell with20percent padding. Same character and clothing details across every direction, neutral limbs pointing down, hidden joints fully drawn so pieces can move. Panel order upper-left EAST/right profile; upper-middle SOUTHEAST/front three-quarter down-right; upper-right SOUTHWEST/front three-quarter down-left; lower-left WEST/left profile; lower-middle NORTHWEST/rear three-quarter up-left; lower-right NORTHEAST/rear three-quarter up-right. Back views MUST show back of head and clothing, not mirrored front. Within EACH panel exact piece order: row1 head with neck, chest torso excluding arms and excluding skirt below belt, rear cloak/mantle; row2 front lower robe/pelvis, anatomical left upper arm, anatomical right upper arm; row3 anatomical left forearm and empty hand, anatomical right forearm and empty hand, left leg knee-to-ankle; row4 right leg knee-to-ankle,left boot,right boot. All weapons must be OMITTED; hands empty. No glow baked into body. Use very clear isolated pieces. 
Character: Lean youthful male royal herald, chestnut hair, open face, small blue feathered cap, gold-trim royal-blue fitted coat with ivory split skirt, light brass pauldrons, blue rear half-cape, fitted trousers and brown knee boots. Mobile court messenger silhouette, not full plate Knight. Equipment separate brass herald trumpet with small royal-blue pennant and short ceremonial sword.
equipment: Create a transparent 2D cel-shaded fantasy equipment sprite atlas for Royal Herald. Style: Arcane Vanguard, bold clean dark contours, hard shadow planes, readable game prop shapes. Equipment: brass herald trumpet with small royal-blue pennant and short ceremonial sword. Character style context: Lean youthful male royal herald, chestnut hair, open face, small blue feathered cap, gold-trim royal-blue fitted coat with ivory split skirt, light brass pauldrons, blue rear half-cape, fitted trousers and brown knee boots. Mobile court messenger silhouette, not full plate Knight. Equipment separate brass herald trumpet with small royal-blue pennant and short ceremonial sword.. ONLY equipment, no people, body parts or hands. No text/grid/labels/background/ground shadows. All props fully in cells with15percent padding. Exactly twelve props in3columns4rows. Each consecutive pair is primary weapon then secondary shield/trumpet: anatomical right-hand ceremonial sword followed by left-hand brass trumpet with blue pennant. Pairs are E,SE,SW,W,NW,NE in row-major order.Genuine six directional views, show backs/straps where appropriate in NW/NE. Keep all handles vertical with grip lower end and head at top; trumpet may point outward horizontally. Clean standalone silhouettes, no glow baked in, exact grid.
vfx: Create an animation-ready 2D cel-shaded VFX atlas for Hollow Vale Royal Herald. TRUE TRANSPARENT background. Exactly8columns4rows,32 isolated square frame cells, each padded, no text/labels/grid/background/characters/equipment. Each row is an eight-frame non-loop effect from start to peak to disappearance. Row1 short sword slash; row2 golden rally sound-wave rings; row3 friendly rally relocation swirl; row4 royal spawn shimmer. Use ivory/gold with royal-blue accents. Crisp hand-drawn flame-free HOLY magic, clean shapes, no photoreal smoke, no characters. Effect source centers remain in same point within cells to avoid jitter. Lastframe nearlygone. Effects only as described, no invented attacks or abilities. Sheet 2:1 landscape. All8frames must be visually distinct.
